name: @freva-org/stac-browser
description: Private workspace holding Freva's centrally owned recipe for building Radiant Earth's STAC Browser into materials an enabled portal can embed. Never published, and never run unless a deployment enables the stac-browser component.

scripts.build: node -e "console.log('stac-browser: nothing to build by default; run prepare:upstream, which fetches and builds upstream')"

$scriptsComment: There is deliberately no script named exactly 'prepare'. npm runs 'prepare' for every workspace during 'npm ci' and 'npm install', so that name would fetch and compile a third-party application - and install its ~800 dependencies - on every ordinary bootstrap, which is the one thing this workspace exists to avoid. tests/no-install-hooks.test.mjs enforces it.
$filesComment: An allow-list, not an ignore-list. This workspace is private and is never published, but a private flag is one boolean away from being wrong, and what would then be published is a compiled third-party application plus its upstream checkout. What is listed here is the RECIPE: the pin, the reviewed patch series, the scripts and the licence evidence. dist/, materials/ and .upstream/ are absent by construction rather than by .gitignore.
